summary: Iteration 4 frontend regression + new feature testing (TraceabilityChain, SupportingDocuments, UX polish, accessibility). All acceptance criteria verified on Jordan Lee (ret-2025-001). Queue shows 12 returns, empty search state shows 'Clear search'. Button labels on wages field exactly: 'Use suggested value', 'Keep current value', 'Enter my own value'. Accept-AI dialog title 'Use the suggested value?' + confirm button 'Use suggested value'; toast 'Suggested value applied' with description 'Wages, salaries, and tips is now Verified.' Source tab renders traceability-chain (origin + 4 numbered steps + return node), plus supporting-documents card with primary + supporting doc entries. Interest field aggregation shows chain-origin-multi-node with 2 chain-breakdown-item rows (First Bank $740, Community Credit Union $520) terminating at return node $1,280. Row banner shows 'SUGGESTED VALUE' (no 'AI suggests'). Summary tab uses 'Suggested value' label. Self-employment section shows friendly section-complete callout. Manual correction workflow: dialog title 'Enter your own value', save button 'Save my value', toast description contains 'Original suggestion is preserved in History', pinned-ai-recommendation card renders on Summary, History card shows 'Suggestion snapshot' section. Skip-to-main-content link appears as first focusable element (href='#main-content'). No console/page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: EvidencePanel.jsx is 936 lines — consider splitting FieldHistory / AuditSection / ValueComparison / ConflictResolver into separate files (>700 line guideline).

TraceabilityChain does not render a source card when field has no docId AND is not aggregation — currently shows placeholder text, which is fine; consider hiding entire chain in that case to reduce noise.
AiExtractionEvent uses hardcoded timestamp '2026-01-09T14:03:00Z' — should be sourced from transformation metadata for real audit fidelity.
seed_data_creation: None — all data is mocked client-side.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Note: many UI labels use CSS text-transform: uppercase, so inner_text case checks should be case-insensitive. Wages field state is stateful across tests within same session — after accept-ai, the field flips to Verified so manual-correction test must reload the page or use a fresh session. Data-testids verified working: traceability-chain, supporting-documents, supporting-doc-primary, supporting-doc-supporting, chain-origin-node, chain-origin-multi-node, chain-return-node, chain-step, chain-breakdown-item, pinned-ai-recommendation, accept/keep/manual btns on field-wages-1a, review-dialog-confirm-accept.
